name: Feathermoon Stronghold
summary: Feathermoon Stronghold is the premier night elf military base in southern Kalimdor, situated securely on Sardor Isle off the Forgotten Coast of Feralas. Commanded by General Shandris Feathermoon, this fortified outpost projects Sentinel strength across the wild forest and keeps watch over regional threats.

sections.title: Sentinel Bastion of the South
sections.body: Perched on Sardor Isle across the channel from Feralas's mainland, Feathermoon Stronghold serves as the primary strategic base for the Sentinels in southern Kalimdor. Built among ancient elven groves and supplied with a sacred moonwell, the fortress houses archers, huntresses, and support staff under the direct supervision of General Shandris Feathermoon. From this insular sanctuary, the night elves project their influence over the verdant interior of Feralas, guarding against demonic corruption, hostile wildlife, and encroaching Horde expeditions.

sections.title: A Safe Haven in the Wilds
sections.body: Because the mainland of Feralas is thick with savage beasts, Gordunni ogres, and the tainted shadows of Dire Maul, Sardor Isle provides an essential defensive buffer. Alliance travelers rely on the ferry crossing from the Forgotten Coast to reach its fortified docks, repair their gear, and gather intelligence. The presence of Shandris Feathermoon—adopted daughter to High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind and a veteran of the Third War—ensures that the stronghold remains an unassailable redoubt against all enemies of the kaldorei.

aliases: how to get to feathermoon stronghold
faq.answer: Feathermoon Stronghold sits on Sardor Isle, an island positioned off the Forgotten Coast on the western edge of Feralas. Travelers must journey west across the forest to the coast and take a boat across the water to reach the island fortress.

The stronghold is commanded by General Shandris Feathermoon, supreme commander of the Sentinel army and adopted daughter of High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind. She oversees all kaldorei military efforts throughout southern Kalimdor from this outpost.

faq.q: Why is the stronghold located on an island instead of the mainland?
aliases: why is feathermoon on an island
faq.answer: Sardor Isle offers natural oceanic defenses against the many dangers of mainland Feralas, which is overrun by savage beasts, Gordunni ogres, and lingering arcane and demonic perils. Positioning the fortress on an island provides a secure port that controls coastal waters while keeping mainland threats at bay.

faq.q: Does Feathermoon Stronghold have a moonwell?
aliases: is there a moonwell at feathermoon
faq.answer: Yes, Feathermoon Stronghold maintains a sacred moonwell within its grounds. It provides spiritual focus, sustenance, and a source of holy water for the night elf garrison stationed far from their homeland in the north.

angles.text: For Alliance champions braving southern Kalimdor, Feathermoon Stronghold provides vital supplies, flight paths, and quest headquarters amidst the hostile wilderness of Feralas.
As the main Sentinel encampment south of Ashenvale, this fortress represents the resolve of the kaldorei to safeguard Kalimdor under the leadership of General Shandris Feathermoon.
